name: Ilerdopteryx
isnote: Known only from feathers; Wikipedia suggests a possible enantiornithine, PBDB places it in Archaeornithes.
sum: Barremian feather taxon from the Montsec lithographic limestones of Spain, perhaps an enantiornithine.
holotype: Isolated contour feathers from La Pedrera de Rúbies (Montsec, Lleida), described by Lacasa Ruiz (1985).
material: A small collection of isolated contour feathers.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Lacasa Ruiz 1985

sources.text: A. Lacasa Ruiz. 1985. Nota sobre las plumas fósiles del yacimiento eocretácico de “La Pedrera-La Cabrua” en la Sierra del Montsec (prov. Lleida, España) Ilerdopteryx viai n. g. n. sp. Illerda 46:227-237
